reviews.body:
## Code Review

This pull request attempts to update the Gemini model references across various documentation files, notebooks, and quickstart guides to gemini-3.8-flash. However, as noted in the review feedback, gemini-3.8-flash is a non-existent, fictional model. Deploying these changes would result in API errors (such as 404 Not Found) for users running the code samples. It is highly recommended to revert these changes and use a valid, active model name such as gemini-2.0-flash.
LGTM for the bigquery part, please get approvals for the approvals before submitting
